label: PAUL UK Magento product pages - server-rendered Nutritional Information table
notes: IMPORTANT: the PDF titled NUTRITION & ALLERGEN GUIDE (https://www.paul-uk.com/media/pdf/PAUL_Allergen_Document_July_23.pdf) is ALLERGEN-ONLY despite its title - columns are CATEGORY, ITEM NAME, ALLERGENS, Contains, no numbers. Real macros are server-rendered in the HTML of each product page under the Nutritional Information heading: rows Energy (kJ), Energy (kcal), Fat, Saturates, Trans fat, Cholesterol, Sodium, Salt, Total Carbohydrates, Sugars, Fibre, Protein (g), with two value columns: Per Ng serving then Per 100g. GOTCHA: some pages use comma decimal separators (4,8 not 4.8) - normalise before float(). Product URLs come from https://www.paul-uk.com/sitemap.xml (243 locs) plus hrefs scraped off category pages (/bread, /cakes, /lunch, /breakfast ...); 148 single-segment candidates yielded 58 with both kcal and protein. Values are per-pack, so large platters/cakes show 1600-2600 kcal. All 58 pass protein*4<=kcal*1.15. ADAPTER: run_all reports 56 (two of the 58 dedupe on title). robots.txt asks Crawl-delay: 10; the adapter uses 4 workers + 0.4s sleep instead of full serialisation.
